name: Chat Commands & Kits
author: SCUMSA
description: A complete in-game command & reward system. Custom /commands that reply AND/OR run admin actions (teleport, give currency, spawn, weather…) with rich live tokens ({player}, {online}, {money}, {location}, {x}/{y}/{z}…), optional cost, cooldown and per-player allow/deny. Welcome message on join. Reward packs & kits (items + vehicles picker), free or for money/gold/fame, on join or via command — with cooldowns, per-player claim limits, mutually-exclusive groups and spawn-failure fuses (no charge if it can't be delivered). Every command and every kit can also be limited to a time window — a weekend kit, a happy hour, a command that stops overnight — on the server's real clock, with the player told when to come back. Every player-facing line is configurable in any language. Manage who claimed what and reset it from the panel. Requires the SSA Bridge.

needs.why: Judges whether a player can afford a kit against the balance the running game holds this second. With these off the price is checked against the last server save, so a player can send their money to a friend and still buy the kit.
